note: HAND-MAINTAINED. Vocabulary the reference once defined and has since removed, with the pin at which it went. A removal is the one vocabulary change a consumer cannot recover from the current inventories: an added kind is visible as a new name, but a removed one leaves nothing behind except a digest that no longer matches, and a consumer holding a mapping onto it learns only that the mapping stopped matching. This file is what survives the removal, and it is the counterpart for vocabulary of what retired-versions.json is for published coordinates. It is deliberately not generated: nothing in the current jar can tell you what used to be in an older one.

retired.name: KeywordLaw
retired.reason: Retired with law declarations. `law` is not a keyword at this pin -- it lexes as an ordinary lowercase name, so a grammar still scoping it as a keyword colours a plain identifier.

retired.name: KeywordLawful
retired.reason: Retired with law declarations. The `lawful` trait modifier went with them.

retired.name: CommentList
retired.reason: Parser2 now parses only visible non-comment tokens and attaches nonempty comment runs afterwards as PlainComment or DocComment. The former comment list and empty documentation wrapper are no longer defined.

retired.name: Decl.Law
retired.reason: Flix removed law declarations from the language. `law` is no longer parsed as a declaration inside a trait, so the TreeKind that grouped one can no longer be emitted from any input.

retired.reason: Parser2 now parses only visible non-comment tokens and attaches nonempty comment runs afterwards as PlainComment or DocComment. The former comment list and empty documentation wrapper are no longer defined.
